name: CTRL
positioning_note: Positioning updated 2026-07-26 to match the locked AI-native repositioning (see project-documentation/AGENT_BRIEFING.md section 1). The exact final public tagline/one-liner wording is still TODO(founder); this is the working version, not a locked final.
tagline: Build the AI-native version of your business.
one_liner: CTRL helps a leader build, orchestrate, productize, and take to market the AI-native version of their business: a decision engine that reframes any general-business call into its AI-native version and grounds it in evidence, a Memory Web that makes any AI tool (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Claude Code) instantly know the business, a daily AI-native news briefing, and an Automator that turns one weekly workflow into an installable agent skill.

icp.who: Senior individual leaders: C-suite (CEO, COO, CFO, CTO), VPs, Senior Directors, Founders.
icp.qualifiers: Already uses at least one AI tool daily (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) but gets generic output. Time-poor, pragmatic, privacy-conscious, guards the calendar.
icp.not_a_fit: Individual contributors with no team, students, users wanting a generic chatbot.

problem.headline: Most businesses use AI without becoming AI-native.
problem.detail: Leaders bolt AI onto a business that still runs the old way: they buy a chat tool, put AI on a board deck, and ask their team to 'use AI more', while which workflows a human owns, how the org is wired, what the product is, and how it goes to market never change. General-business questions get answered as general business, with no AI-native angle, while AI-native competitors rebuild around agents and pull ahead.

magic_moment: The first time CTRL reframes a general-business question into its AI-native version and the leader sees the actual, evidence-grounded decision behind it, not generic advice.

pitch.short: CTRL is the tool for building, orchestrating, productizing, and getting to market the AI-native version of your business, one decision at a time.
pitch.long: CTRL never answers a general-business question as general: the decision engine reframes it into its AI-native version, then decomposes it into claims, verifies them against live evidence, cross-examines the call, and shows where it holds and where it breaks. That reframe is grounded in a Memory Web: a structured, encrypted model of who you are, your company, and how you think, built from 2 minutes of voice or text and exportable into any LLM (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Claude Code). Each morning CTRL delivers a briefing filtered to nine AI-native categories, anchored to your real priorities. The Automator turns one weekly workflow into an installable, agentskills.io-compliant skill, free for now.

differentiators: Portable: works across every LLM, not locked to one chat app.
Voice-first: 2 minutes of talking, no forms, no integrations.
Evidence trail: every briefing item shows the memory fact or decision that triggered it.
Encrypted personal context: privacy-first, the user owns and controls the data.
Turns workflows into installable Claude Skills (Edge Pro).

objections.q: Why not just use ChatGPT memory?
objections.a: ChatGPT memory is locked to ChatGPT. CTRL is portable across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, and Claude Code, and is structured and evidence-backed.
Your context is encrypted and you control it. CTRL is privacy-first and built for leaders who guard sensitive context.
About 2 minutes of voice. No integrations, no plugins.

guardrails: No em dashes in any copy.
Do not promise integrations CTRL does not have (it is export-based, not plugin-based).
Do not overstate outcomes; CTRL accelerates clarity and decision speed, it does not replace judgment.
Edge Pro is $49/mo as of 2026-07-04; never quote $9 or $29 (legacy grandfathered prices).
Do not offer the Full Diagnostic / Deep Context / Bundle one-time SKUs as checkout links; they are wired in Stripe but not reachable from any live route.
Lead with the AI-native positioning (build/orchestrate/productize/go-to-market the AI-native version of the business), not the retired 'clarity for leaders / portable AI double' framing.

attribution.scheme: Append UTM params to every fleet-driven link. CTRL captures first-touch on landing, persists through signup into user metadata, and stamps onto the Stripe customer + checkout session at purchase.
attribution.warehouse: Lifecycle events (landed, signed_up, activated, purchased, refunded) are emitted to the central MindmakerOS attribution warehouse (project gojpffsrxybbpbdzzrvs) via the ingest-attribution function. Wiring is dormant in CTRL until WAREHOUSE_INGEST_URL + ATTRIBUTION_INGEST_SECRET are set.

content_assets.daily_briefing: Personal and private per user; not a public feed.
content_assets.note: CTRL has no public content feed by design (briefings contain personal leader context). Fleet content should use the pitch, differentiators, and objections in this document.
